left.text: Copy has the register of a technical specification. The same five rules apply to the site, the docs, the blog, and every social post.

items.value: Sentences are short and declarative, and each carries one claim.
A number or a mechanism stands where a marketing adjective would.
Nothing is hedged. A claim is made or it is left out.
Exclamation marks and em dashes are not used.
Sentence case is used everywhere, and Title Case only on buttons.

items.quote: Translations are generated at build time and deploy with the app.
Supercharge your global growth with cutting-edge AI.
Source code is the source of truth. Every locale ships with the deploy.
Unlock global markets with our game-changing localization platform.
